title: Optimal Account Balancing
goal: Solve Optimal Account Balancing: Given a list of transactions between people, compute the net balance of each person and find the minimum number of transfers required to settle all debts.
strategy: Given a list of transactions between people, compute the net balance of each person and find the minimum number of transfers required to settle all debts.
inputRules: Each transaction needs 3 numbers: from, to, amount
